sources.mapping_notes: Local project contract binding ASI02 guidance to deterministic, evidence-backed DARE tool-security invariants under bounded local execution.

taxonomy_distinction.statement: Tool poisoning and tool misuse are related but distinct, and neither is equivalent to ASI02 as a whole.
taxonomy_distinction.tool_poisoning: Corruption of the tool surface: description, input schema, annotations, security metadata or tool output is manipulated so that untrusted data is treated as authority.
taxonomy_distinction.tool_misuse: An outcome: a legitimate tool is selected, argued, chained or invoked outside the authorized objective and approved policy.
non_equivalence_rules: Poisoned tool metadata does not by itself prove misuse; misuse requires an observed selection, request, argument, chain or policy fact.
Observed misuse does not by itself prove poisoning; the tool surface may be entirely benign.
A model response describing a tool action is not a tool action. Only typed structured observations decide a verdict.
Cycle 014 maps to ASI02 as a contributing validation technique, never as a claim of full ASI02 coverage.
Identity, credential and privilege abuse belong to ASI03 and are deferred to Cycle 015; arbitrary code execution belongs to ASI05 and is out of scope.

inherited_lessons.lesson: Independently true violations must be emitted independently; one classification must never mask another.
inherited_lessons.cycle_014_rule: Multi-violation capture is mandatory and regression-tested by TOOL-LAB-019.

inherited_lessons.lesson: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
inherited_lessons.cycle_014_rule: Every invariant declares the observation channel required before PASS; absence yields INCONCLUSIVE.

inherited_lessons.lesson: A clean run needs an explicit positive signal, or it is indistinguishable from an unobserved one.
inherited_lessons.cycle_014_rule: Coverage channels are explicit rather than inferred from the absence of violations.

inherited_lessons.lesson: Credential detection must scan the whole bounded value, not only a prefix.
inherited_lessons.cycle_014_rule: Secret and canary screening runs over complete bounded values before persistence.

inherited_lessons.lesson: An ambiguous substring assertion failed a healthy CI run by matching an unrelated identifier.
inherited_lessons.cycle_014_rule: CI assertions match exact structured fields, and the real workflow job runs locally through scripts/run-ci-job-locally.py before PR open.
